item.title: Innovation in Action: One Student’s Push to Improve Memory Care
item.description: After spending years volunteering in hospitals and nursing homes, Jonathan Xue witnessed patients’ gradual memory deterioration, and developed accessible, at-home cognitive tests.

item.title: Spring Break Film Watchlist
item.description: I believe that films centered around young adulthood, travel, and young-adult stories are fitting for spring vacation. With this in mind, here is a list of five films that fit the overall sentiment of Spring Break.

item.title: From Punta To Passing Time on the Couch: A Spring Break Playlist
item.description: This playlist is a way of splitting the difference between a plethora of vibes and reawakening your appreciation for life, no matter where you’re spending your Spring Break.

item.title: Newton Police Investigate Mystery Pig Leg Near Auburndale Trail
item.description: The Newton Police Department (NPD) is investigating what they believe to be a full “pig leg or flank” found just off a walking trail near Flowed Meadow at the Auburndale Cove on Sunday.

item.title: Proposed Crafts Street Development Continues To Face Pushback From Zoning Board and Residents
item.description: The Newton Zoning Board of Appeals (ZBA) met on Wednesday to hold its third hearing on a proposal for a 234-unit residential development on a 2.7-acre lot on Crafts Street in Nonantum.

item.title: No. 10 BC’s Offense Falters in 3–1 Loss to BU
item.description: No. 10 Boston College lost to Boston University for the first time this season on Friday night as the Eagles' offense faltered, resulting in a 3–1 loss to the Terriers.

item.title: Vermont Takes Down BC 3–1 in Hockey East Quarterfinals
item.description: No.3-seed Boston College women's hockey was looking to extend its season with a win over No. 6-seed Vermont in the quarterfinals of the Hockey East Tournament, but the Eagles could not find enough offense as the Catamounts emerged with a 3–1 victory to end BC's season.

item.title: Dropkick Murphys To Honor Welles Crowther With “Red Bandana Night”
item.description: Dropkick Murphys will be in Boston between March 13 and March 17 to perform their annual series of hometown shows for St. Patrick’s Day. The Massachusetts-born Celtic punk band is the group behind “I’m Shipping Up to Boston,” which has been adopted by Boston College sports fans and turned into a rallying cry for the University.

item.title: Ten Years Later, Bruno Mars Doubles Down on Romance in ‘The Romantic’
item.description: This Friday, Bruno Mars released his first album in ten years with The Romantic. The tracklist is nine songs totalling 31 minutes, making for a short but sweet listen to the pop star’s newest entry in a stellar catalogue.

item.title: Newton Conservation Commission Approves Relocation of Fish, Waban Home Redesign
item.description: The Newton Conservation Commission met on Thursday to discuss the proposed relocation of native fish from Bullough’s Pond to the City Hall ponds, as well as changes to a home construction plan that required the commission’s approval.
